base_scenario.label: base
base_scenario.narrative_en: The most likely path: it tracks the broad market, drifting sideways to modestly higher without a decisive breakout either way.

recommendations.dissent_summary: Bull case: in a strong advance the underlying (IWM) typically out-totals a covered-call wrapper; high yield is not outperformance.
recommendations.dissent_summary_ko: 강세 시각: 강한 상승장에서는 기초자산(IWM)의 총수익이 커버드콜을 대개 앞섭니다 — 높은 수익률이 곧 초과성과는 아닙니다.

recommendations.rationale_en: We read Global X Russell 2000 Covered Call as a hold on the short horizon — composite score 52/100, 66% confidence. risks: Capped upside — lags the underlying in strong advances (opportunity cost).

recommendations.fundamental_summary: Covered-call/option-income ETF: distribution yield ~8.8%. Writes calls on IWM — trades upside for income; distribution is not total return and may include return of capital.

recommendations.dissent_summary: Bull case: a market-state upturn or a positive catalyst could re-rate this faster than the scores imply.

recommendations.rationale_en: We read Wells Fargo as a hold on the short horizon — composite score 49/100, 66% confidence. Above all, ePS estimates revised up (3 up vs 1 down, 30d). That said, realized volatility 21% (annualised). We'd step back if a daily close below the 50-day MA (~86.74).

recommendations.fundamental_summary_ko: ETF·키리스 — 개별 기업 펀더멘털이 해당 없거나 수집되지 않았습니다.
recommendations.valuation_summary: No valuation model — no target price (avoids false precision).
recommendations.valuation_summary_ko: 밸류에이션 모델 없음 — 목표가를 제시하지 않습니다(과도한 정밀함 회피).

bull_scenario.label: bull
bull_scenario.narrative_en: The uptrend holds: sector leadership and inflows stay supportive and buyers defend pullbacks, so the stock keeps making higher highs.
bull_scenario.narrative_ko: 상승 추세 유지 — 섹터 주도력과 자금 유입이 우호적으로 이어지고 눌림목마다 매수가 들어와 고점을 높여가는 흐름입니다.

base_scenario.label: base
base_scenario.narrative_en: The most likely path: it tracks the broad market, drifting sideways to modestly higher without a decisive breakout either way.
base_scenario.narrative_ko: 가장 가능성 높은 경로 — 시장 전체와 보조를 맞춰 뚜렷한 돌파 없이 횡보~완만한 상승에 머무는 흐름입니다.

bear_scenario.label: bear
bear_scenario.narrative_en: Risk case: volatility (~21% annualised) expands, relative strength rolls over, and Technology lags the market on any risk-off turn.
bear_scenario.narrative_ko: 위험 시나리오 — 변동성(연 ~21%)이 커지고 상대강도가 꺾이며, 위험회피 전환 시 Technology이(가) 시장보다 부진한 흐름입니다.

recommendations.dissent_summary: Bull case: a market-state upturn or a positive catalyst could re-rate this faster than the scores imply.
recommendations.dissent_summary_ko: 강세 시각: 시장 국면이 개선되거나 호재가 나오면 점수가 가리키는 것보다 빠르게 재평가될 수 있습니다.
